gs.profil.offen: A contract talk is under way
gs.ui.ok.vertrag_abgelehnt: The talk is postponed. The player will ask again later.
gs.ui.fehler.gesperrt: The player has just been turned away. He will ask again later.
gs.ui.fehler.bedingung_laeuft: He is still working on the condition you agreed.
gs.folge.wechsel.leicht: %1 accepts it but thinks about other options.
gs.folge.wechsel.stark: %1 wants out at the next chance.
gs.folge.vertrauen.hoch_stark: %1 now believes almost anything you say.
gs.folge.vertrauen.runter_stark: %1 hardly believes your words any more.
gs.folge.moral.hoch: %1 walks into the dressing room in better spirits.
gs.folge.vorstandsvertrauen.hoch: The board looks at you more calmly.
gs.folge.vorstandsvertrauen.hoch_stark: The board clearly stands behind you.
gs.folge.vorstandsvertrauen.runter: Brows are furrowed in the boardroom.
gs.folge.fanstimmung.runter: There is grumbling on the terraces.
gs.folge.medienbild.hoch: The press writes kindly about it.
gs.folge.medienbild.hoch_stark: The press praises how you handled the player.
gs.folge.medienbild.runter: The press picks up the dispute.
gs.folge.medienbild.runter_stark: The press makes the dispute a headline.
gs.folge.abloese.neu: A fee of %2 is agreed with %1.
gs.folge.sperre.neu: %1 will ask again on %2 at the earliest.
gs.anfrage.eroeffnung: %1 lets his agent know: “Gaffer, I want to talk about my contract.”
%1 asks through his agent: “Have you got a minute? It's about my future here.”
gs.anfrage.satz.bedingung_tore: I'd like to extend – score %2 goals in the next %3 games and you are first in line for a new deal.
gs.anfrage.satz.bedingung_einsaetze: I want to keep you – start %2 of the next %3 games, then we talk.
gs.anfrage.satz.bedingung_note: Show me an average rating of %2 or better in the next %3 games and you get your offer.
gs.anfrage.satz.verhandeln: Let's sit down and talk numbers right away.
gs.anfrage.satz.spaeter: Give me some time, we'll talk about it later.
gs.anfrage.satz.absage: Right now I can't offer you a new contract.
gs.anfrage.satz.erfuellen: Fine, we meet your demand, and you meet the condition.
gs.anfrage.antwort.verhandeln: %1 nods: “All right, let's look at the numbers.”
gs.anfrage.antwort.spaeter: %1 shrugs: “Fine. I'll come back to it in a few weeks.”
gs.anfrage.antwort.erfuellt: %1 shakes on it: “Then it's a promise.”
gs.anfrage.antwort.ablehnen: %1 shakes his head: “Not like that. It's too one-sided.”
gs.anfrage.antwort.absage.hart: %1 raises his voice: “Then I know where I stand. I won't forget it.”
gs.anfrage.antwort.absage.mild: %1 swallows: “A pity. I expected more, but I understand.”
gs.anfrage.forderung.spielzeit: a fixed place in the starting eleven
gs.anfrage.haerte.murren: Will ask for something in return
gs.anfrage.absage_folge: Wish to leave %1, mood and relationship suffer, four to eight weeks of peace
gs.vorfall.anfrage_presse.text: The press reports that %1 feels rebuffed by the gaffer. The club has said nothing so far.
gs.vorfall.anfrage_bereit.text: %1 has met the agreed condition. The contract offer is ready for negotiation.
gs.vorfall.anfrage_verfehlt.text: %1 did not reach the agreed condition. He is sulking and will stay quiet about the contract for now.
